description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp\Pool class, which manages concurrent HTTP requests by sending an iterator of requests with a capped pool size, utilizing promises for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: Handles concurrent sending of HTTP requests using a pool with a specified maximum concurrency. It wraps and manages promises for asynchronous request execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Pool with a client, a requests iterator or array, and configuration options such as concurrency and request options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all requests in the pool are completed.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes a batch of requests concurrently and returns an array of responses or exceptions in the order of the requests.
